decisive_items: Epithelial malignancy of thymic origin, showing ovoid-to spindle neoplastic cells with nuclear atypia and mitosis
Right anterior mediastinal mass, well demarcated with minimal contact with surrounding great vessels and no adjoining abnormal lymph nodes
response.rationale: Biopsy confirms thymic epithelial malignancy, which is definitive for thymic carcinoma. Other candidates lack histologic confirmation and are less specific.

rejected.why: Symptoms and imaging suggest heart failure but biopsy provides a more specific diagnosis.
Hypertension is present but not the primary cause of the mediastinal mass.
Elevated troponin and ECG changes are nonspecific and contradicted by patent coronary arteries on angiography.
